content: I will focus on the key points and avoid unnecessary repetition. Microbiota Oral Therapy for Recurrent Clostridioides difficile Infection (rCDI): 1. Indication and Dosage: Microbiota oral therapy, containing bacterial spores, is indicated for the prevention of recurrent Clostridioides difficile infection (rCDI) in adults following antibacterial treatment for rCDI. The recommended dosage is 4 capsules taken orally once daily for 3 consecutive days. Prior to the first dose, patient preparation instructions should be followed as outlined in the administration guidelines. 2. Limitations of Use: This therapy is not indicated for the treatment of active Clostridioides difficile infection (CDI). The safety and efficacy of this therapy have not been established for other uses. 3. Drug Interactions: Antibacterial agents, including but not limited to amikacin, amoxicillin, ampicillin, azithromycin, aztreonam, bacitracin, cefaclor, cefadroxil, cefazolin, cefdinir, cefditoren, cefepime, cefepime/enmetazobactam, cefiderocol, cefixime, cefotaxime, cefotetan, cefoxitin, cefpirome, cefpodoxime, cefprozil, ceftaroline, ceftazidime, ceftazidime/avibactam, ceftibuten, ceftizoxime, ceftolozane/tazobactam, ceftriaxone, cefuroxime, cephalexin, chloramphenicol, ciprofloxacin, clindamycin, colistin, dalbavancin, daptomycin, delafloxacin, demeclocycline, dicloxacillin, doxycycline, eravacycline, ertapenem, erythromycin (base, ethylsuccinate, lactobionate, stearate), fidaxomicin, fosfomycin, gemifloxacin, and others, may reduce the efficacy of microbiota oral therapy due to pharmacodynamic antagonism. Co-administration of these agents should be avoided, or alternative drugs should be considered. 4. Timing of Antibiotic Regimens: To minimize the risk of reduced efficacy, complete any ongoing antibiotic regimens 2 to 4 days prior to initiating microbiota oral therapy. 5. Mechanism of Interaction: The bacterial spores in microbiota oral therapy may be adversely affected by concurrent antibacterial agents, which can inhibit their activity and reduce the therapeutic benefits.
